query:
SELECT jsonb_build_object(
'observedAt',clock_timestamp(),
'cases',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('count',count(*),'fingerprint',md5(coalesce(string_agg(to_jsonb(t)::text,'' ORDER BY id),''))) FROM public.stellar_support_cases t),
'contacts',(SELECT jsonb_build_object('count',count(*),'fingerprint',md5(coalesce(string_agg(to_jsonb(t)::text,'' ORDER BY id),''))) FROM public.ai4cc_contacts t),
'workflows',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.stellar_orchestrator_workflows_staging),
'events',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.stellar_orchestrator_events_staging),
'receipts',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.stellar_dispatch_receipts_staging),
'effects',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.stellar_dispatch_effects_staging),
'rls',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('table',relname,'enabled',relrowsecurity)) FROM pg_class WHERE oid=ANY(ARRAY['public.stellar_support_cases'::regclass,'public.ai4cc_contacts'::regclass,'public.stellar_orchestrator_workflows_staging'::regclass,'public.stellar_orchestrator_events_staging'::regclass,'public.stellar_dispatch_receipts_staging'::regclass,'public.stellar_dispatch_effects_staging'::regclass])),
'functions',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name',proname,'bodyHash',md5(prosrc),'serviceExecute',has_function_privilege('service_role',oid,'EXECUTE'),'anonExecute',has_function_privilege('anon',oid,'EXECUTE'),'authenticatedExecute',has_function_privilege('authenticated',oid,'EXECUTE'))) FROM pg_proc WHERE pronamespace='public'::regnamespace AND proname=ANY(ARRAY['stellar_dispatch_claim_staging','stellar_dispatch_verify_staging','stellar_dispatch_receive_staging','stellar_dispatch_ack_staging','stellar_dispatch_fail_staging']))
) AS evidence;
